description: Source code for the 'File' class managing disk cache file operations, including reading, writing, and IO handling with asynchronous support.

classes.name: disk_cache::File
classes.description: Manages disk cache file operations including synchronous and asynchronous read/write, length management, and IO completion handling.

methods.name: File::Init
methods.description: Initializes the file with a given path and opens it with read/write flags.

methods.name: File::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the underlying file handle is valid.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file at a specified offset into a buffer.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file at a specified offset from a buffer.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Asynchronous read operation with callback support.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Asynchronous write operation with callback support.

methods.name: File::SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: File::GetLength
methods.description: Returns the current length of the file.

methods.name: File::WaitForPendingIOForTesting
methods.description: Waits for all pending IO operations to complete, used in testing.

methods.name: File::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops any pending IO operations, static method.

methods.name: File::DoRead
methods.description: Performs the actual read operation on a worker thread.

methods.name: File::DoWrite
methods.description: Performs the actual write operation on a worker thread.

methods.name: File::OnOperationComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations, invoking callback.
